content: For Chinese NLP tasks, we pre-train the model using Chinese corpus. We collected textual data (10879M tokens in total) from the website, consisting of Hudong Baike data (6084M tokens) , Zhihu data(465M tokens) , Sohu News(3937M tokens) and Wikipedia data (393M tokens).
